clock_note: capture_wall_ns in capture_log.csv and monotonic_ns in CUE_EVENTS.jsonl are on the same monotonic clock (same magnitude, cue 0 lands 15.9 s after row 0); label = last cue onset at or before capture; transition flag = under 2 s since onset (reaction lag unmeasured)
label_semantics: CUE ASSIGNMENT, NOT OBSERVED POSE. Each row carries the spoken cue whose onset was the last at or before the row's capture clock. Nothing in this JSON was derived from pixels. A separate held-contact-sheet inspection, reported in 20260823_august_cue_compliance_note.md, found the cued pose in 12/12 sampled +5 s frames; it is not a per-row label audit. A row may precede the subject's reaction (transition flag under 2 s is a guess, reaction lag unmeasured), may show an imperfect or different pose, or may be a missed cue. That sampled bridge does not establish the pose in proof 4's row: the row may be described as captured under cue X, never as showing pose X.
